jobs.title: Data Analyst, New Grad
jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. As a Data Analyst, New Grad, you will turn product, job market, and user data into actionable insights that improve search, recommendations, and user experience.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze product, user, and job market data to identify trends and opportunities
• Write SQL queries and build recurring reports or dashboards
• Define and monitor key product and business metrics
• Support A/B tests and evaluate the impact of new features
• Investigate data quality issues and improve reporting accuracy
• Present findings clearly to product, engineering, and business stakeholders
Qualification

Required

• Recent graduate or graduating soon in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field
• Strong SQL skills and familiarity with spreadsheets or Python
• Understanding of basic statistics, data analysis, and experimentation
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work remotely within the United States

Preferred

• Experience with pandas, scikit-learn, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools
• Familiarity with product analytics, recommendation systems, or search
• Experience working with large or messy datasets
• Previous internship, research, or analytics project experience

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Data Analyst, Senior Level
jobs.description:
Jobright is an AI-powered job search agent that helps people streamline their job search and reach better employment outcomes. The Senior Data Analyst owns product and business analysis, metric and dashboard development, data quality and statistical evaluation, stakeholder recommendations, complex technical initiatives, and team mentorship.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze product and business data with SQL to explain trends, customer behavior, and operational performance
• Define metrics and build reliable dashboards and recurring reports with clear definitions
• Investigate data quality issues and reconcile findings across source systems
• Design and interpret funnel, cohort, and experiment analyses with appropriate statistical checks
• Communicate findings and practical recommendations to product and business stakeholders
• Lead technical design and delivery for complex initiatives in this role, making tradeoffs explicit
• Mentor colleagues and improve review, documentation, and operational practices
Qualification

Required

• Practical experience delivering data analysis from an initial business question through a documented recommendation
• Strong SQL skills, including joins, window functions, and aggregation
• Ability to build and validate dashboards using a business intelligence tool
• Working knowledge of statistics, experiment interpretation, and data quality checks
• Clear written communication and the ability to collaborate with a remote team
• Demonstrated experience owning complex projects from design through production or business adoption
• Ability to lead technical decisions, review others' work, and mentor colleagues

Preferred

• Experience with Python or R for reproducible analysis
• Familiarity with product analytics, event instrumentation, and metric governance
